name: Tennessee
dueDateNotes: Federal estimated payments are due April 15, June 15, September 15, and the following January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Tennessee does not tax personal income, so your quarterly estimates cover federal self-employment and income tax only.
uniqueFacts: Tennessee has no state income tax, so your quarterly estimated payments are federal only.
Tennessee's Hall Tax on interest and dividends was fully repealed in 2021.
